test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jul 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

You are the ______ to the throne and should behave in such a manner.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Heir**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Heir **means a person who is entitled to inherit a particular position or property. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी विशेष पद या संपत्ति को प्राप्त करने का हकदार है)

 
 
• **For example- ***She is the sole heir to the estate.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate word to use in the given sentence as it refers to the person's position in the royal family.
 
• The word is pronounced as "**air**" but spelt with an "**e**" before the "**i**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**Complete sentence**: *You are the heir __to the throne and should behave in such a manner.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Hair**" refers to the strands that grow on the head or body. (सिर या शरीर पर उगने वाली लटें)
 
• "**Here**" indicates a location or position. (एक स्थान या पद)
 
• "**Hare**" is a type of rabbit. (एक प्रकार का खरगोश)
